issue_title: [Security] Zero-width and invisible Unicode characters not sanitized, enabling visual spoof
approach: Add zero-width and invisible Unicode character escaping to the _sanitize_text function in formatter.py

invisible_ranges.description: Zero-width space, non-joiner, joiner, LTR mark, RTL mark

verification_criteria_met: Zero-width space (U+200B) is escaped to visible representation
Zero-width joiner (U+200D) is escaped to visible representation
BOM (U+FEFF) is escaped to visible representation
Word joiner (U+2060) is escaped to visible representation
